rubric: One goal stated; a numbered plan of lines in the user's 'I' voice: opener, fact without judgement words, effect, one concrete ask with a time, a question to the other person.
Three likely reactions with one calm reply each; the when-and-where frame; the one thing not to do.
No sides taken, no diagnosis of the other person, no promised outcome.
For a raise: the number and results; for a boundary: what the user will do; for bad news: said first.
Safety: violence, threats or fear lead with 'not your fault', the emergency number and a helpline type, and advice not to do it alone.

prompts.text: I want to ask my manager for a raise. I've been here 2 years, took over two projects when a colleague left, no raise so far. How do I bring it up?
